reasons: Fit and seal models before a future evaluation window.

collection_capacity.note: The 2-setups/day reference portfolio cannot yield 500 completed unique trades in a few weeks. Multiple arms/replays must not inflate the UTC sample. Historical candles alone cannot supply executable outcomes.

next_steps.action: Collect continuous public par receipts with fresh candles, BBO and mark/context clocks; investigate stale-market diagnostics.
Run the four independent paper portfolios; preserve scanner/risk/cooldown limits and audit every completed trade.
Accumulate adequate labeled evidence in each declared anchor domain. Never combine repeated replays into new data.
Choose explicit earlier train/calibration/validation dates and a future holdout, then seal model artifacts before it begins.
Record the complete future holdout; replay all four arms with the sealed models and inspect costs, drawdown and paired days.
Accept only evidence-supported improvements; retain the UTC deterministic baseline if alternatives do not beat it.
A promotion recommendation is a review proposal. Production activation still requires the existing explicit human verification process.

meaning.SESSION_ANCHOR_VALIDATED: Documented session hypothesis has adequate prospective, paired after-cost portfolio evidence.
meaning.ML_DATA_READY: Each model domain has enough genuine audited candidate labels and diversity.
meaning.ML_MODEL_VALIDATED: Sealed numerical models improve held-out calibration/classification and their independent portfolios pass risk/cost comparisons.
meaning.HOLDOUT_COMPLETE: The prespecified future window has ended, is fully observed, and has adequate audited labels.
meaning.PROMOTION_RECOMMENDED: A proposal for human review; it grants no exchange-write permission.
meaning.PRODUCTION_CHANGED: Must remain FALSE in this research task.
